baseline.scope: Open-source Akaunting core routes and documented default features

coreCapabilities.title: Business dashboard
coreCapabilities.gap: Saved layouts and saved reports exist. Summary, receivables, payables, cash, and tax widgets use posted-ledger reports; recent activity is operational. There is no expenses-by-category widget, and drill-down rows link to a document or the accounting page rather than the journal lines behind every total.

coreCapabilities.title: Products and services
coreCapabilities.gap: Media and per-item multiple-tax behavior remain open.

web.gap: No web E2E proves media or multiple taxes.

mobile.gap: Media and multiple taxes are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Customers
coreCapabilities.gap: A single postal address is stored. Contact people, separate billing and shipping addresses, statements, bulk import/export, and portal login remain open.

web.gap: No authenticated portal or statement E2E exists.

mobile.gap: Contacts, statements, and portal workflows are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Sales invoices
coreCapabilities.gap: Cancel, restore, archive, duplicate, history, line discounts, multiple line taxes, attachments, and CSV import/export are implemented. Send and remind return 503 EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE unless a mail provider is configured. Recurrence is the recurring-activity capability.

coreCapabilities.title: Vendors and bills
coreCapabilities.gap: The API covers vendor contacts and defaults, attachments, history, cancel/restore, split payments, and vendor CSV. Web page tests only cover the import-link permission. Recurring bills are the recurring-activity capability.

web.gap: Page tests cover the import link, not cancel, restore, or split payment.

mobile.reason: Core parity is proved by the API and web workflow; mobile expense expansion is tracked by mobile coverage.

coreCapabilities.title: Payment/bank accounts
coreCapabilities.gap: Default payment account, statements, performance, bulk state changes, and a unified posting model remain open.

web.gap: No E2E proves statements, defaults, or bulk state changes.

mobile.gap: Statements, defaults, and bulk state changes are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Transfers
coreCapabilities.gap: Same-currency transfers and reviewed-rate cross-currency transfers post equal and opposite reconciled legs. Web BankTransferDialog and mobile BankTransferFormScreen do not send exchangeRateId, so those screens cannot complete a cross-currency transfer. Transfers have no edit or void lifecycle.

mobile.reason: Akaunting core parity is proved on web; a native reconciliation workflow is tracked by mobile coverage.
Akaunting core parity is proved on web; native accounting administration is tracked by mobile coverage.

coreCapabilities.title: Financial reports
coreCapabilities.gap: Statements, the general ledger, and account statements are calculated from posted journals with cash/accrual, comparison, and account, customer, and vendor filters. categoryIds is accepted and ignored because journal lines have no category. baseCurrency is fixed to NZD, and foreign-currency documents are excluded from GST instead of converted.

coreCapabilities.title: Tax
coreCapabilities.gap: GST configuration, returns, and IRD filing exist, and invoice lines can carry multiple taxes. A reusable tax-rate catalogue and compound or withholding tax types are not implemented.

web.gap: Open catalogue and multi-tax paths are not covered.

mobile.gap: Native tax settings and multi-tax workflows are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Currencies and localization
coreCapabilities.gap: The organisation catalogue, immutable dated rates, locale, timezone, and financial-year settings exist, and invoices, bills, expenses, and explicit-rate transfers snapshot base amounts. Realized and unrealized exchange-difference journals are not posted. Financial reports stay NZD and do not convert foreign amounts. The settings screens have no dedicated automated test.

coreCapabilities.title: Company settings
coreCapabilities.gap: Business identity, invoice defaults, and template appearance exist. Currency, locale, and financial year are the currency-settings API. Email templates, reminder schedules, and a notification centre are not implemented.

mobile.gap: Communication, currency, and locale settings are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Companies/organisations
coreCapabilities.gap: Create, rename, switch, and ledger isolation are implemented and tested. Archive is implemented on POST /api/organisations/:id/archive and in the web and mobile company screens, but no automated test calls it. Restore and ownership transfer are not implemented.

coreCapabilities.title: Users and permissions
coreCapabilities.gap: Fixed owner, admin, accountant, member, and read-only roles, hashed invitations, and server permission checks are implemented. Custom roles are not implemented, and invitations are share links rather than outbound email.

coreCapabilities.title: Customer portal
coreCapabilities.gap: Customers cannot authenticate, manage profiles, or list invoices, statements, payments, and receipts.

contract.gap: Portal identity and resource contracts are missing.

api.gap: Public share tokens exist, but authenticated portal authorization is missing.

web.gap: Public sharing is not an authenticated portal.

mobile.gap: Public sharing is not an authenticated portal.

coreCapabilities.title: Attachments/uploads
coreCapabilities.gap: Invoices, bills, and bank transactions store organisation-scoped attachments. Items and customer contacts do not. Mobile invoice and bill screens list attachments, and no mobile test covers upload or authorization.

mobile.gap: Screens list attachments. No mobile test covers upload or authorization.

coreCapabilities.title: Import/export
coreCapabilities.gap: Items, invoices, vendors, bill export, and bank transactions have preview or import and export paths. Customers, accounts, journals, categories, and taxes do not.

coreCapabilities.title: Search, bulk actions, notifications
coreCapabilities.gap: Items support server bulk activate, deactivate, and delete. There is no organisation-scoped cross-domain search and no persistent notification centre.

mobile.gap: Native search, bulk actions, and a notification centre are not implemented.

coreCapabilities.title: External API and API keys
coreCapabilities.gap: No API-key lifecycle, scoped external API, OpenAPI publication, or webhook delivery exists.

contract.gap: External API contracts and OpenAPI output are missing.

api.gap: API-key and webhook integration tests are missing.

mobile.reason: Human-facing mobile apps must not carry external API keys.

coreCapabilities.title: Mobile coverage
coreCapabilities.gap: Dashboard, invoices, customers, items, expenses, purchases, bank accounts, transactions, transfers, reports, company and team, recurring schedules, and currency settings have Expo screens. Reconciliation, the customer portal, journal administration, and authenticated native-device QA remain open.

contract.reason: Mobile consumes the domain contracts recorded by each capability.

api.reason: Mobile consumes the same Hono APIs recorded by each capability.

web.reason: This row measures the native client.

extensions.title: First-party module catalogue
extensions.decision: Catalogue decisions are planned but do not block core parity.

extensions.title: Estimates and quotes
extensions.decision: Implemented as the shared quote and estimate slice; it remains outside the core gate.

extensions.title: Automated bank feeds
extensions.decision: Requires a provider and architecture exception decision.

extensions.title: Connector framework
extensions.decision: Requires named integration approvals and certification.
